prompt: Was the founder of the bank that was established 42 years before the National Banking Act was expanded to include the Territory of Hawai'i still alive when it acquired Pioneer Federal Savings Bank?
answer: No. The bank was **First Hawaiian Bank**, founded in 1858 as Bishop & Co. by **Charles Reed Bishop** (with William A. Aldrich). Bishop died in **1915**, long before First Hawaiian acquired Pioneer Federal Savings Bank on **August 6, 1993**. Thus, he was not alive at the time of the acquisition.
